Before & Afters Specials Memberships Shop Online Menu of Services Book Now Current Specials Book Online Home / Our Practice Home / Our Practice Our Practice Cosmetic Enhancement Center of New England is the oldest and largest cosmetic facility in Maine. We are proud to offer an array of non-surgical cosmetic services to the residents of Portland and the surrounding cities of New England. About Our Practice About Our Practice Cosmetic Enhancement Center of New England is New England’s premier cosmetic practice. As Maine’s largest and oldest cosmetic practice, we have a long history of providing our patients with exceptional care no matter what services they are receiving. As our practice continues to grow and welcome new patients, we remain firm in upholding our high standards of patient care and cosmetic expertise. Today, we offer a wide range of cosmetic services. We are proud to offer some of the most highly demanded treatments, such as dermal fillers and injectables. Thanks to the expertise of our team, we are also able to offer new and advanced services like laser treatments. Plus, we are proud to offer a variety of non-surgical alternatives to some of the most desired cosmetic surgeries. Whatever your treatment goals may be, we are eager to discuss your treatment options with you and help you determine the best solution for you. Where Can I Learn More About Cosmetic Enhancement Center of New England?
